pub fn eq<T>(
        self,
        define_opaque_types: DefineOpaqueTypes,
        expected: T,
        actual: T,
    ) -> InferResult<'tcx, ()>
    where
        T: ToTrace<'tcx>,
    {
        self.trace(expected, actual).eq(define_opaque_types, expected, actual)
    }
